title: Verify the Sandbox HUD after a gameplay edit

inspect.summary: Inspect the score display and the starting score.
inspect.why: Players rely on the HUD for immediate feedback.

apply.summary: Build and reload the edited SandboxGame module.
apply.why: Check the HUD against the binary that contains the gameplay change.

review.summary: Check HUD visibility and the score reported by the game.
review.why: Together these cover the visible HUD and its initial game state.

checks.label: Fresh session starts at score zero
